name: Seishun Ouka
source:
The protagonist is a college Ronin who lives with his father. With the college entrance exam just one month away his father suddenly remarries, and now he has a step mother and two step sisters. 

In this multi-scenario game overflowing with guilty pleasure, you have just one month to sneak around behind your fathers back and make your step mother and step sisters yours.  

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1181]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名与父亲同住的大学复读生。距离大学入学考试还有一个月时，父亲突然再婚了，现在他有了一个继母和两个继姐妹。在这部充满背德快感的多路线游戏中，你只有一个月的时间在父亲背后偷偷行动，将继母和继姐妹据为己有。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1181]Getchu.com[/url]]
